summary: Institutional positioning is overwhelmingly bullish, characterized by massive long-dated call buying in SPX and XOM. The most significant conviction is seen in SPX 4700C and 4750C strikes for 2027, totaling over $2.1B in single-day accumulations, alongside heavy XOM 110C-130C buying for 2026. Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in extreme out-of-the-money SPX 7000C calls (expiring 2026) with over $5.5B in cumulative premium, signaling a massive long-term macro bet on index expansion. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in SPX and XOM, specifically monitoring if the $4700 level in SPX holds as a floor for these long-dated premium flows.
